report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: high-severity TOCTOU in worktree.py, high-severity multi-segment dir pattern bug, high-severity missing cancellation integration test, low-severity fragile dry-run gate. Order: TOCTOU fix (blocks others), dir pattern fix, cancellation test, dry-run test.
risks: TOCTOU fix may introduce performance regression if re-verification is heavy
IgnoreRules fix may break existing patterns if edge cases not considered
Cancellation integration test may be brittle if timeout timing is flaky
todos: Fix TOCTOU in worktree.py: add re-verification before os.rmdir/os.unlink
Fix IgnoreRules._hit for multi-segment dir_only patterns
Write integration test for cancellation propagation
Add test that gate runs even with dry_run=True

items.title: Fix TOCTOU race in worktree.py by adding re-verification before syscalls
items.why_now: Blocks all other worktree operations; unpatched race could allow directory traversal outside worktree.

steps.do: In worktree.py, before each os.rmdir and os.unlink call, call _verify_reachable again on the exact path to re-check it's still within the worktree.
steps.verified_by: Code review: ensure _verify_reachable is called immediately before each destructive syscall. Run existing tests: pytest tests/.

items.assumption: worktree.py contains _verify_reachable function and os.rmdir/os.unlink calls; path is assumed based on finding context.

items.title: Fix IgnoreRules._hit for multi-segment unanchored dir_only patterns
items.why_now: Current code fails to match patterns like 'a/b' against 'a/b/c.py', causing incorrect ignore behavior for multi-level directories.

steps.do: In daedalus/ignore.py, modify _hit method: if rule.dir_only and len(rule.pattern_segments) > 1, join candidates into a path and compare with pattern using fnmatch.
steps.verified_by: Write test with pattern 'a/b' (unanchored, dir_only) and path 'a/b/c.py' expecting True. Run: pytest tests/test_ignore.py::test_multi_segment_dir_only

items.assumption: daedalus/ignore.py exists; pattern_segments is accessible; test file is tests/test_ignore.py.

items.title: Write integration test for cancellation propagation from gate_candidates to runner
items.why_now: No cross-module test verifies that cancellation token passed to gate_candidates stops run_attempt within timeout, risking hangs.

steps.do: Create test that calls gate_candidates with a cancel token (e.g., threading.Event) and verifies the runner stops before timeout.
steps.verified_by: Search for existing test: grep -r 'cancel' tests/ --include='*.py' | grep -i 'gate_candidates\|run_attempt'. If none, write test in tests/test_cancellation.py and run: pytest tests/test_cancellation.py

items.assumption: gate_candidates and run_attempt are importable; need to locate correct test directory.

items.title: Add test verifying gate runs even when dry_run=True
items.why_now: Current code is safe but fragile; test prevents regression if publish_to_pr is refactored.

steps.do: Inspect publish_to_pr to confirm screen_egress is called before dry_run check. Add test that calls publish_to_pr with dry_run=True and verifies gate (screen_egress) was invoked.
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection of publish_to_pr code. Run new test: pytest tests/ -k dry_run

items.assumption: publish_to_pr function exists; screen_egress is its gate; need to locate test file.
